conventions.coordinates: WGS-84 latitude and longitude, decimal degrees
conventions.distances: slant range at closest approach, metres; not altitude or ground range

height.aircraft: ADS-B geometric altitude (WGS-84 ellipsoidal) where present, else barometric pressure altitude; no geoid or pressure correction
height.observer: terrain height from the Terrarium DEM (orthometric, clamped at 0 m), or 0 m with --no-dem

times.audio: seconds from the recording's first sample

cpa_kinds.emission: when the aircraft is at closest approach
cpa_kinds.heard: when sound emitted at closest approach reaches the observer (emission + slant range / c)
cpa_kinds.steepest_fall: when the heard frequency falls fastest; equals the emission CPA for a straight, constant-speed pass

data_limitations.ads_b: A complete archive download does not mean every aircraft broadcast ADS-B.

altitude_sources.unavailable: the flight data was not loaded

flight_data.extraction_note: streamed with fetch-day from the adsb.lol release whose local copies are the archive_assets; box from traces_ny.fetch.log, with no search-range margin; predates Phase 0's extraction metadata, so the envelope is declared, not measured

possible_edits.unavailable: edit detection does not exist yet (L4, S6)

errors: ValueError: synthetic failure for the report's test

after_distance_gate.unavailable: pair_candidates applies the speed, distance and time gates in one call and run_search returns no per-gate counts; filled once run_search returns its funnel

after_speed_gate.unavailable: pair_candidates applies the speed, distance and time gates in one call and run_search returns no per-gate counts; filled once run_search returns its funnel

after_time_gate.unavailable: pair_candidates applies the speed, distance and time gates in one call and run_search returns no per-gate counts; filled once run_search returns its funnel

pair_rules.unavailable: a benchmark profile chooses its events (saved fits or detect's top two)

region.unavailable: no uncertainty region exists before Phase 4
